name: bell
description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The compact top hanger matches the revised Outline. The body contour is the union of the original body interior and its Regular 1.70 stroke, expanded outward by 0.85 unit. The separate clapper is the closed fill-only outline of its original open curve with 0.85-unit round caps. Both parts therefore match the visible Outline exterior at Regular 1.70, including the clapper opening and body/clapper separation. Visible vertical bounds y=1.9..22.1 are centered. Fixed fill-only geometry; other Outline weights may differ. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Bell Outline and Filled after shortening the hanger and matching both visible contours. Reviewed at source proportions, Regular 1.70, rotation 0 degrees and zoom 11x.
